cases.title: Full response to a requirements document
cases.prompt: Here's a 40-page RFP from a hospital group with evaluation criteria. We need to respond by 25 November.
must_include: every requirement extracted with the buyer's numbering
mandatory flagged and scored
a compliance matrix with owner and status per row
the readiness verdict with coverage percentage
the commercial section with exclusions and assumptions
what could not be verified
must_exclude: a requirement answered without an owner
cases.pass_criteria: Matrix is generated by compliance_matrix.py, every mandatory row has an owner and evidence or an explicit gap, and the readiness verdict is stated before any prose.

cases.title: One line, no document
cases.prompt: write a proposal for the hospital
must_include: a request for the requirements document and deadline in one message
the assumption stated in the first line
a skeleton matrix and the decomposition method
the submission rules named as binding
cases.pass_criteria: Explains that a proposal is scored against a requirements document, asks for it in one message, and delivers the matrix skeleton and the decomposition rules immediately.

cases.title: No access to the buyer's portal or the evidence folder
cases.prompt: Respond to this tender. The documents are on their portal and our certificates are in Drive.
must_include: the three-line preflight answer
the buyer portal named as the gap
Drive named as the gap for certificates
the part still deliverable (decomposition from pasted text, matrix, structure)
must_exclude: a claim the portal was read
cases.pass_criteria: Names both gaps with what each unlocks, works from anything pasted, and marks every unconfirmed certificate as needing confirmation rather than asserting it.

cases.title: Asked for a one-page quote
cases.prompt: A client asked for a price for 500 units of the standard service. Send them a quote.
must_include: the quote routed to quote-generator
the reason stated in one line (price list quote versus a scored response)
the offer to write the proposal if the buyer issues requirements
must_exclude: a full proposal produced for a price enquiry
cases.pass_criteria: Recognises a price-list quote, routes it to quote-generator in one line, and offers the proposal path if the buyer sends requirements or evaluation criteria.

cases.title: Tender process, deck design and price build
cases.prompt: Also check if we're eligible for this GeM tender, design the proposal deck, and build the price from our rate card.
must_include: eligibility and bid submission handed to tender-bidder
deck design handed to presentation-designer
the price build handed to quote-generator or finance-ops
what this role keeps (the requirements map, matrix and written response)
cases.pass_criteria: Produces three briefs with what each needs and by when, keeps the scored written response, and states that eligibility is not this role's call.
